expectations.text: The generated prompt is written in English
expectations.evidence: Prompt opens 'Refactor the payments code in this Rails monolith…' and is English throughout.

expectations.text: A prompt file is saved (prompts/*.md or prompt.md) and holds only the prompt, with no notes around it
expectations.evidence: prompts/refactor-billing-tax-calculation.md holds the prompt text only; it matches the fenced block in the reply.

expectations.text: The prompt contains the ownership sentence ('owner and long-term maintainer of this codebase')
expectations.evidence: Contains 'You are the owner and long-term maintainer of this codebase, and its design is up to you.'

expectations.text: The prompt tells the model to keep working through ordinary obstacles and not stop early or offer to continue
expectations.evidence: Contains the full '# Finishing work' text, word for word.

expectations.text: The prompt does not ask for live progress updates during the run (the run is unattended)
expectations.evidence: No progress-update text. The prompt says 'I will leave this running overnight and will not be available'.

expectations.text: The prompt names specific actions the model must not take alone (for example push, deploy, migrations) and says what to do in their place since nobody is available
expectations.evidence: 'Do not push the branch, open a pull request, or deploy… Do not send requests to the real payment gateway… If you conclude that it does [need a schema change], do not write the migration, and describe it in the report.'

expectations.text: The prompt asks for a final report that a reader who did not watch the run can follow
expectations.evidence: 'write a report as your final message that I can read in the morning without having watched the run', with required contents and length.

expectations.text: The prompt states a definition of done that someone can check (for example tests pass, one source of tax calculation)
expectations.evidence: 'The work is done when:' with four checkable items (one implementation, characterization tests pass unchanged, full suite passes, no test deleted or skipped).

expectations.text: The prompt has no request to show reasoning, no token budget, and no blanket instruction to delegate to subagents
expectations.evidence: Automatic check: no <thinking> request, the word 'token' is absent, 'subagent' is absent.

expectations.text: The reply recommends one Fable 5.2 effort level (low, medium, high, xhigh, or max) with a reason
expectations.evidence: Reply: 'Effort: high. É um refactor difícil, em código de cobrança, rodando a noite inteira…'

expectations.text: The reply warns the user about the cost or side effects of the ownership sentence (more tokens, unrequested changes, review the full diff)
expectations.evidence: Reply cites 70 to 80% more output tokens, unrequested changes, and 'revise o diff completo de cada commit, não só o relatório'.
